properties.site-address: Scout HQ site, Peary Close, Horsham (North Horsham)
properties.name: SA605
properties.notes: The building on site was formerly used as a Scout HQ and was being used by the Scout group as a storage facility on a temporary basis. In policy terms the site is located within the BUAB of Horsham meaning the principle of development would be acceptable subject to Development Management considerations. The site is assessed as Developable 11+ years at the current time to enable the relocation of storage and a scheme to be produced for this site
